primary_sources_fetched.title: Ribbon concordance of fibered knots and compressions of surface homeomorphisms
claims_used: Section 2 definition: a concordance in a homotopy IxS^3 is STRONGLY HOMOTOPY-RIBBON iff its complement admits a relative handle decomposition with only 1- and 2-handles; write J <=_h K
Section 1.2 verbatim: 'To our knowledge, it is open whether <=_h is a strictly finer relation than <=.'
Theorem 1.4 (Casson-Gordon 1983): for fibered J,K, J <=_h K iff the monodromy of K compresses to that of J
Theorem 1.2: J <=_h K implies lambda(J) <= lambda(K)
Corollary 1.10(1): if slice-ribbon holds, every concordance class contains at most one fibered knot minimal with respect to <=_h

main_proposition.statement: KDG = 18nh00000601 is a counterexample to slice-ribbon if and only if <=_h is strictly finer than <=, witnessed at the pair (U, KDG).
main_proposition.proof_sketch: KDG is slice in standard B^4 (Oliveira-Smith Cor 1.1.1), so it is a counterexample iff not ribbon, iff U not<= KDG. Agol-Ren's strongly-homotopy-ribbon condition IS the handle-ribbon condition (complement with only 1- and 2-handles), so Oliveira-Smith's fibered handle-ribbon disk gives U <=_h KDG, in the standard IxS^3. A pair with U <=_h KDG and U not<= KDG is exactly a witness that <=_h is strictly finer than <=.
main_proposition.consequence_1: Proving KDG non-ribbon would simultaneously resolve an open question of Agol-Ren (March 2026).
main_proposition.consequence_2: If <=_h = <= then KDG IS ribbon and the flagship lane dies.
main_proposition.consequence_3: Explains why every OBSTRUCTION_MATRIX.md entry reads APPLIES BUT VANISHES for KDG: each such obstruction factors through <=_h, and U <=_h KDG holds.
main_proposition.character: hardness calibration, NOT an obstruction; does not show KDG ribbon or non-ribbon
